g3_histogram_kde.png.what: Distribution of final grades with a smoothed KDE curve.
g3_histogram_kde.png.why: Shows the grade range, concentration, and shape before classification.
g3_histogram_kde.png.actual_result: Mean G3 was 10.42; median G3 was 11.00.
g3_histogram_kde.png.limitation: A univariate distribution does not explain why grades differ.

g3_by_studytime_boxplot.png.what: Grade distributions, medians, and potential outliers across study-time categories.
g3_by_studytime_boxplot.png.why: Compares the spread of grades among reported study-time groups.
g3_by_studytime_boxplot.png.limitation: Study time is self-reported and group differences are observational.

numeric_correlation_heatmap.png.what: Pairwise Pearson correlations among numeric variables.
numeric_correlation_heatmap.png.why: Highlights linear relationships that can guide further exploration.
numeric_correlation_heatmap.png.actual_result: The numeric feature with the largest absolute Pearson correlation with G3 was G2 (0.905).
numeric_correlation_heatmap.png.limitation: Correlation is not causation and Pearson correlation can miss nonlinear relationships.

absences_vs_g3.png.what: Student absences plotted against final grade with a fitted linear trend line.
absences_vs_g3.png.why: Explores a possible linear association between absence counts and final grade.
absences_vs_g3.png.actual_result: Pearson correlation between absences and G3 was 0.034.
absences_vs_g3.png.limitation: The trend line is descriptive; confounders and overlapping observations are not controlled.

mean_g3_by_studytime.png.what: Mean final grade in each of the four study-time categories.
mean_g3_by_studytime.png.why: Provides a compact comparison of group averages.
mean_g3_by_studytime.png.actual_result: Highest group mean was 5-10h (11.40); lowest was <2h (10.05).
mean_g3_by_studytime.png.limitation: Means hide within-group variation and do not imply that study time caused the differences.
